answer: Operator Liability Lantern. Each agent identity carries a signed operator link to a registered legal entity; when a cluster of identities is flagged, the registry freezes the operator’s entire identity allowance, not individual wallets. An attacker hitting the detection nadir loses all identities at once, making each marginal fake identity cost the whole namespace. A clean operator can harbor one flagged wallet without shutdown, since only proven sybil clusters trigger the freeze.
